description: Single source of truth for Luxar demo dataset disposition (R17). bucket: zenodo=fetch-on-demand redistributable; local-compute=fetch raw + build locally (not redistributable); regenerate=cheap CPU rebuild (not hosted). See scripts/gen_data_manifest.py.

cc-by.title: Luxar demo datasets: permissively licensed (CC-BY, CC0, public domain)

h2afva.title: Zebrafish embryogenesis, histone-labelled nuclei: 253-timepoint light-sheet timelapse as Gaussian splats (with a lighter 51-timepoint fit)

droso-timelapse.title: Drosophila melanogaster embryogenesis: a 500-timepoint light-sheet timelapse as Gaussian splats

neuromast-z.title: Neuromast 2-channel light-sheet timelapse as Gaussian splats (Z-corrected, isotropy 2.31)

acquisition.description: the scikit-image `kidney` sample, all 3 channels of which are fitted

gsplats_cells3d.source: scikit-image (data.cells3d) — Allen Institute for Cell Science

acquisition.description: the scikit-image `cells3d` sample, both channels of which are fitted
Aperio CMU-1.svs, a ~169 MB multi-resolution slide pyramid
acquisition.reason: the file stores every pyramid level and the fit reads one, then resizes it, so its size would price the levels that were never fitted rather than the compression of the one that was

gsplats_cryoem_virus.attribution: EMDB is public domain / CC0. Map: EMD-5384.

acquisition.description: EMD-5384 `emd_5384.map.gz` -- the whole map, as downloaded
a TotalSegmentator subset, repacked locally into an npz
acquisition.reason: the download is a multi-scan subset and the demo repacks selected scans into its own npz, so neither the download nor the repack is the same array the fit represents

acquisition.description: the `mean` array inside Zenodo 3993082 `mean_std.h5`, measured with its own HDF5 storage size
acquisition.note: the FILE is 2.4 GB but holds mean AND std, and the fit reads only the mean, so the file size is not the denominator -- h5py's per-dataset get_storage_size() is

The Astronomical Journal (2026, accepted); arXiv:2503.14745. The catalogs are defined in DESI Collaboration. DESI 2024 II: sample definitions, characteristics, and two-point clustering statistics. JCAP 2025(07), 017. doi:10.1088/1475-7516/2025/07/017. CC BY 4.0; use requires the DESI citation and acknowledgment text at https://data.desi.lbl.gov/doc/acknowledgments/.

gsplats_celegans.attribution: Santella, Kovacevic, Bao, Hirsch — doi:10.5281/zenodo.6460303 (CC BY 4.0).

acquisition.description: the Zenodo TIFF timelapse, every timepoint of which is fitted

gsplats_visible_human_head.source: NLM Visible Human Project (Male head, PNG)
gsplats_visible_human_head.attribution: U.S. NLM Visible Human Project (public domain; acknowledge NLM, no endorsement implied).

acquisition.reason: the fit converts colour photographs to a single greyscale volume and crops it to content, so a ratio against the stored photographs would price a colour conversion, not compression

gsplats_nexrad_supercell.source: NOAA NEXRAD Level II, KTLX (Twin Lakes, OK), 2013-05-31 21Z - 06-01 03Z
gsplats_nexrad_supercell.attribution: U.S. NOAA/NWS NEXRAD Level II via NOAA Open Data Dissemination (public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105; acknowledge NOAA, no endorsement implied). Derived product: regridded and Gaussian-fitted, not original NOAA data.

acquisition.description: 82 NEXRAD Level II scans (~800 MB gzipped)
acquisition.reason: the scans are polar sweeps carrying several moments and elevation angles, of which the demo re-grids ONE moment inside one box, so the figure would price dropping the other moments and the polar-to-Cartesian resampling

milky_way_gaia_3m.reason: CC BY-NC (non-commercial) — incompatible with a cleanly-reusable host.
milky_way_gaia_3m.strategy: Build on demand with `luxar demo run gaia_milky_way -- --build-catalog` (queries the ESA Gaia archive, no GPU) into ~/.cache/luxar/, or place a copy there. Requires the ESA/Gaia/DPAC acknowledgement.

gsplats_tng_cosmic_web.reason: Access-gated (account + API key); no redistribution license.
gsplats_tng_cosmic_web.strategy: Fetch particle data after TNG registration + fit locally (GPU).

gsplats_acto3d_heart.reason: Repo MIT covers software only; sample data unlicensed (all rights reserved).
gsplats_acto3d_heart.strategy: Fetch raw from the Acto3D source + fit locally (GPU).

gsplats_flylight_mcfo.source: FISBe v1.0 (Zenodo 10875063) / Janelia FlyLight Gen1 MCFO
gsplats_flylight_mcfo.attribution: FISBe (Mais et al., CVPR 2024; doi:10.5281/zenodo.10875063, CC BY 4.0). Imagery from the FlyLight Project Team, Janelia Research Campus, HHMI; cite Meissner et al. eLife 2023 12:e80660 and Tirian & Dickson 2017 for the VT line.
gsplats_flylight_mcfo.reason: CC BY 4.0 and redistributable, but no Zenodo record is published yet.
gsplats_flylight_mcfo.strategy: Range-extract one sample (~415 MB) from the 7.1 GB Zenodo archive + fit locally (GPU). The archive is never fetched whole.

gsplats_tribolium.reason: CTC origin forbids cloning; Zenodo re-host CC-BY is an authority conflict.
gsplats_tribolium.strategy: Fetch raw from the Cell Tracking Challenge + fit locally (GPU), or seek CTC permission.

dipc_genome.strategy: Small GEO download + CPU polyline build; auto-download+rebuild fallback already in the demo.
